neighbours.label: the words 'sudden' / 'suddenly' (abrupt change)
fire: Call a doctor if you notice sudden numbness in your face or arm.
The car stopped suddenly and the driver jumped out.
There was a sudden drop in temperature after midnight.
She suddenly remembered that she had left the oven on.
A sudden gust of wind knocked over the umbrellas.
The market fell suddenly when the news broke.
His sudden departure surprised everyone at the office.
The dog suddenly barked at the empty doorway.
quiet: Call a doctor if you notice mild numbness in your face or arm.
The car stopped slowly and the driver got out.
There was a steady drop in temperature after midnight.
She later remembered that she had left the oven on.
A gentle gust of wind moved the umbrellas.
The market fell slightly when the news broke.
His planned departure was announced at the office.
The dog quietly watched the empty doorway.
